rows.07:c920:
"I'll kill you!"
Then, her face twisted with rage, Iwashita attacked.
...Not me, but Arai.
Arai must never have seen that coming.
As the two of them grappled, the chisel ended up in Iwashita's hand.
"Die! Die! Drop dead!"{p}
rows.07:cac0:
Arai's white shirt was turning red with blood.
And as his shirt grew redder, his face grew paler and paler.
He was no longer breathing.
"{a}!"
Suddenly, Iwashita turned to face me.
One look at her face, and I couldn't move.
I had never seen a human face so horribly transformed.
Iwashita was going to kill me.
Then, without warning, Iwashita drove the chisel into her own face.
"If this painting is gone, I'll die too.
The senior I loved painted it for me.
My senior graduated, leaving this painting behind, so I killed them.
I never forgive anyone who leaves me behind.
...{a}, I'll go on ahead and wait for you in Hell.
Your life will be over soon too, you know."
I couldn't stop her.{p}
